page: Google Cloud Platform a3-edgegpu-8g-nolssd is an accelerator-optimized virtual machine featuring eight NVIDIA H100 GPUs with a total of 637 GB of VRAM. The system is powered by dedicated Intel Xeon 8481C processors with 208 vCPUs, 104 physical cores, and a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. It includes 1872.0 GB of system memory, providing 9.0 GB of RAM per core. This instance does not include any local SSD storage.

Benchmark results indicate top-tier multi-core CPU performance, with high scores in multi-threaded bzip3 decompression and Passmark CPU tests. Memory bandwidth is also in the top tier, reaching 423.79 GB/sec for large block reads. The platform demonstrates strong capabilities in large language model inference, processing 5430.06 tokens per second for a medium 7B model. However, single-core CPU performance and Passmark memory scores remain in the average tier.

Given the high density of specialized hardware, this server offers qualitative cost efficiency for massive parallel computing workloads where GPU-to-CPU communication is critical, though the lack of local SSD storage requires external storage solutions. The architecture is designed for large-scale artificial intelligence workloads, deep learning training, LLM inference, and complex scientific simulations.
